Privacy policy

Last updated: 17 October 2026

This policy explains how the Commercial Opportunity Network website and prototype handle information.

The prototype

Everything you enter in the platform, including objectives, drafts, RFQs, offers and bookings, is stored only in your browser’s local storage. It is not sent to any server. You can delete it at any time below, or with “Your data” in the platform header.

Early access requests

The early access form prepares a message that you send yourself by email. It does not send or store anything. We receive nothing until you send that message, and then use your details only to reply and to organise the pilot.

Your data in this browser

This site stores the following only in your browser. Delete any part on its own, or all of it. No other site is affected.

Fonts

The site loads the Cairo typeface from Google Fonts, which means your browser may connect to Google’s servers.

The live platform

No live service exists yet. Before one launches, a full privacy notice will be prepared with legal advice, including how UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data applies, and covering legal basis, retention periods, processors and your rights.

Contact

For privacy questions, write to:
